items.summary: Product recommendation: prioritize operating-system improvements before new site work. The largest friction is execution throughput: 191 approved proposals lack execution requests, 46 failed-request repairs remain open, 25 deployed improvements await measurement, and only 1 outcome is proven. Retain three reversible workstreams: reconcile approved work into the existing engineer queue, add failure deduplication and owner-routing controls, and standardize deployment-to-measurement handoff using only existing telemetry. Keep gated launches private and preserve all unknowns; do not add telemetry, schedules, access, spend, or production changes directly.

Product recommendation: prioritize portfolio execution controls before new site work. Evidence shows 191 approved proposals without execution requests, 46 failed-request repairs open, 25 deployed improvements awaiting measurement, and only 1 proven outcome. Retain three reversible workstreams: reconcile eligible approved work into the existing engineer queue, define failure deduplication and owner-routing controls, and standardize deployment-to-measurement handoffs using existing telemetry only. Keep gated launches private, preserve unknowns, and make no direct production, access, spend, schedule, or telemetry changes.

Recommendation: preserve the execution, failure-containment, and measurement themes, but do not create duplicate work items or new production requests. Evidence from the 30-day scorecard: 191 approved proposals lack execution, 46 failed-request follow-ups remain open, 25 deployed improvements await measurement, and only 1 outcome is proven. Unknown: contribution margin, ROI, causal lift, and operational health remain unavailable. Smallest next step: update the existing execution-sprint, failure-containment, and measurement work items with these control requirements. Owner decision: authorize the prepared Woot permission request; SearchWoot remains private unless and until the owner authorizes outreach.

Reject the candidate plan's three new work items as duplicates, not because the objectives are invalid. Fold approved-work reconciliation into the existing owner execution sprint, failure deduplication and routing into contain-failed-work, and deployment-to-measurement handoff into the existing measurement-gates work. No new change_request is justified because the actionability scorecard reports no unblocked implementation candidate and the reviewer/CTO disposition is to drain existing backlog first.
